package.name: jedy_odometry
package.description:
Wheel odometry for Jedy's mecanum base, built ON the driver rather than inside it.
This is an ESTIMATOR and that is why it is a separate package. actuo publishes what the wire says -- a raw potentiometer pulse, and no velocity at all -- and anything worked out from that appears here, where nothing downstream can mistake it for a measurement. The numbers it needs are this robot's too: the pot's pulses per revolution and the window the board clamps the reading to. actuo must not learn either.
